description: Per-namespace retrieval-verification dataset for the uniswap namespace (2 live tools). Every live tool has blind rows (no brand word) and protocol-aware rows (brand named). Queries were written from the manifests and the navigation entry only, phrased the way a model would type them into tool search on the user's behalf. The generic swap-pricing and swap-execution rows are deliberately worded like the sibling kyberswap dataset's rows so the venue-pair behaviour (D11: both venues' quote tools returning close together for a plain swap query) is observable; the Robinhood Chain rows cover the coverage this venue uniquely serves.
